decks.notes: The primary strategy of this deck is to utilize the "Living End" card to quickly and efficiently cycle through creatures and bring them back onto the battlefield at once. The deck focuses on creatures with cycling abilities, such as Architects of Will, Curator of Mysteries, and Street Wraith, to consistently cycle through the deck and set up for a powerful Living End. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Negation to protect the combo and ensure its success. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a sudden onslaught of powerful creatures and disrupt their game plan.

This deck focuses on aggressive early game plays using powerful creatures and disruptive spells to control the board and pressure the opponent. The key concept is to quickly establish board presence with efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, while disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize. The deck also utilizes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Lightning Bolt to deal with threats, and can close out games quickly with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing control elements to disrupt opponents while building up a strong board presence with powerful creatures like Delighted Halfling and Omnath, Locus of Creation. It also includes key planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Wrenn and Six to control the game and generate value. Leyline Binding helps to lock down opponent's threats, while Prismatic Ending provides versatile removal. The deck aims to control the game until it can overwhelm the opponent with its powerful creatures and planeswalkers.

The deck focuses on utilizing a variety of control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while generating card advantage and tempo through powerful threats like Omnath, Locus of Creation and Wrenn and Six. The deck aims to control the board using removal spells like Solitude and Leyline Binding, while also being able to protect its own threats with Counterspell and Teferi, Time Raveler. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional power and resilience to the deck's strategy, making it difficult for opponents to overcome its disruptive game plan.

This deck focuses on casting Cascade spells to quickly flood the board with powerful creatures and disruption spells. With cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a quick and aggressive game plan. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Tishana's Tidebinder help control the opponent's board state, while cards like Dead / Gone provide additional removal options. By taking advantage of the Cascade mechanic, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain tempo throughout the match.

The main concept of this Modern Rakdos Aggro deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy with cards like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize, while also applying early pressure with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate, while also using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Kolaghan's Command to generate card advantage. By combining disruption, aggression, and removal, this deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent and secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategy by quickly deploying threats and disrupting opponent's game plan with hand disruption. It utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Grief to apply early pressure, while also using Dauthi Voidwalker and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to disrupt opponent's graveyard interactions. The inclusion of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Terminate allows for dealing with opposing threats efficiently. The deck also includes a mix of land destruction and recursion to further disrupt opponent's mana base and maintain board presence.

The key concept of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing powerful spells and countering the opponent's threats. The deck includes a variety of removal spells, such as Damnation and Fatal Push, to deal with opposing creatures. It also utilizes counter spells, such as Archmage's Charm and Force of Negation, to prevent the opponent from resolving important spells. The centerpiece of the deck is The One Ring, which allows the player to gain incremental advantage over time. Overall, the deck aims to mitigate the opponent's actions while generating card advantage and ultimately win the game through control.

This deck focuses on controlling the game through a combination of powerful creatures and targeted removal spells. By utilizing cards like Delighted Halfling and Omnath, Locus of Creation to pressure the opponent while also disrupting their game plan with cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending, this deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler further solidifies the control aspect of the deck by preventing the opponent from executing their game plan effectively.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing powerful control cards and disrupting the opponent's strategy. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Damnation to control the board and disrupt the opponent's hand, combined with powerful finishers like Karn, the Great Creator and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and dictate the pace of the game. With a mix of removal spells, card advantage, and powerful threats, this deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver its opponent in a game of attrition.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize. It also includes strong early game threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push and Terminate. The deck aims to control the board with Molten Collapse and Orcish Bowmasters, while also pushing for damage with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provides a powerful late-game threat, backed up by Undying Evil to bring back key creatures. The inclusion of Blood Moon can also disrupt opponents' mana bases.
